run.scope: smoke, text-review, test-ui, test-settings, test-puzzles, test-store, test-progression, catalog, test-performance
run.summary: smoke: Gate passed: a clean install reaches the age gate in 3.5 s, the first launch flow (age gate, story, welcome, tutorial level) works, and all 10 main-menu buttons open something. One trivial issue: no favicon, so every load logs a 404. text-review: The copy is clean: no spelling or grammar errors in 861 strings, and the numbers in the text match the game data. The issues are consistency ('bees' vs 'bugs', 'in line' vs 'in the line') and two in-context layout problems seen only in the running game: tutorial dots drawn over the ad banner text and a cramped No Ads subtitle. Three queries ask whether demo wording and placeholder legal links are intended for the public build. test-ui: Tablet and desktop layouts are clean. On phones the top bar is too wide: at 360 px the Settings gear and the store's close X are cut or pushed off screen, completely from 9,999 coins. In phone landscape (web only; the Android app is portrait-locked) the Levels/Play block covers the Activities and Events buttons. test-settings: All 7 checks pass. The switches apply at once, survive a reload and the UI always matches the saved value. 'Sounds off' is proven by the audio engine: 0 effects played while tapping blocks, against 4 with sounds on. test-puzzles: All 102 levels are solvable and every mechanic was won in the real game by playing its solution. The fail flow works. One minor bug: Add Slot from the Out of Slots popup has no maximum, so repeated fails grow the board to 10+ squeezed slots, past the 7 the Add Slot booster allows. test-store: Prices, deltas, refusals and limits are correct in 13 of 15 checks. One major bug: once No Ads is owned, the store keeps selling the $4.99 Special Offer that includes No Ads. A double tap buys two coin packs (query). test-progression: Progression and daily systems are solid: rewards, unlock boundaries, the 7-day calendar, tasks and backup-save recovery all pass. One major bug: the Level Complete popup can be dismissed by tapping outside it or pressing Escape, which skips the coin reward and leaves the player on an empty board. catalog: Tutorial, simulated ads and save-on-close all work. Several buttons are smaller than the 44 px touch-target guideline (top-bar currency buttons, store Buy buttons, in-level Pause and Speed). test-performance: All budgets met on the test machine: boot 3.1 s (2.5 s of it is the designed loading screen), 1% low 90-119 fps, 58 fps at 4x CPU throttle, 1-3 hitches per minute, heap growth 0.95 MB/min (just under the 1 MB/min budget; worth a 10-minute run on a phone).

findings.title: No favicon: every page load logs a 404 error in the console
steps: Open the game in a browser with the developer console open
findings.expected: The page declares an icon and the console stays clean
findings.actual: index.html has no <link rel="icon">; the browser requests /favicon.ico, gets 404 and logs 'Failed to load resource'. Seen on every boot in this run.

evidence.caption: 404 on /favicon.ico and no icon link in index.html

findings.suggested_fix: Add <link rel="icon" href="assets/sprites/bee.png"> (or a favicon.ico) to index.html. It also gives the browser tab an icon.

findings.title: The swarm is called 'bees' in some texts and 'bugs' in others, even in two consecutive How to Play cards
findings.expected: One term for the creatures the player sends out. The game has 6 bug types (Bee, Ladybug, Beetle, Butterfly, Ant, Firefly) and a 'Bugs' collection tab, so 'bugs' is the general term; 'bees' is only right when the Bee is equipped.
findings.actual: How to Play card 2 says 'bees fly out of the tree', card 3 says 'bugs enter the picture'. The tutorial and three toasts say 'bees'; the lock toast and a notification say 'bugs'.

evidence.caption: Card 2 'bees fly out', card 3 'bugs enter the picture'
...bees fly out of the tree to eat pixels of its color.
From the bottom up: bugs enter the picture from the bottom...
Tutorial: ...bees fly out of the tree to eat its color.
Tutorial: Bees eat from the bottom up...
Tutorial: ...no bee can reach its color...
Toast: The bees are eating {color} pixels
Toast: This {color} block is waiting for the bees
Toast: No free slot — wait for the bees!
Toast: Locked! The bugs must collect its key

findings.suggested_fix: Use 'bugs' in all general texts (e.g. 'bugs fly out of the tree', 'Bugs eat from the bottom up', 'wait for the bugs'). Optionally insert the equipped bug's name where the sentence is about the current swarm.

findings.title: Tutorial step dots are drawn on top of the ad banner text at the bottom of the game screen
steps: Start the first level as a new player (or open the build with #tutorial)
Look at the bottom of the screen while the first tutorial bubble is shown
findings.expected: The six tutorial step dots sit in free space and the banner text stays readable
findings.actual: The dots are painted over the middle of the banner text on every run, whichever banner slide is showing (Halloween Event on run 1, Hard Mode on run 2, Gallery on run 3)

evidence.caption: Close-up, run 3: dots over 'Collect all 102 pictures and share them'
Full screen, run 1: dots over the 'Halloween Event' banner text

findings.suspected_cause: Likely the dots are positioned a fixed 14px from the bottom of the screen, which is inside the 50px ad banner (.ad-banner, css/style.css:761).
findings.suggested_fix: Place the dots inside the tutorial bubble, or offset them above the banner (bottom: banner height + 14px); hide the banner during the tutorial if that is acceptable.

findings.title: Store: the No Ads subtitle is cramped and leaves 'ads' alone on a second line on phone widths
steps: Open the Store from the bottom navigation
Look at the No Ads card under the Special Offer
findings.expected: 'Remove banner and video ads' readable, letters not touching, no single-word orphan line
findings.actual: At 390px the outline makes letters touch and 'ads' wraps alone; at 360px it wraps after 'and' and stays cramped

evidence.caption: Full store at 390px (run 3): 'ads' alone on line 2

findings.suspected_cause: A 3px text stroke on 13px text eats the space between letters; the card title area is narrow next to the price button.
findings.suggested_fix: Reduce the stroke for the small subtitle (1.5 to 2px) or drop it, and shorten the copy to 'No banner or video ads'.

findings.title: Purchase toasts say 'Test purchase' and the banner says 'Demo ad' in the public build
steps: Open the Store
Tap the $0.99 gems pack
findings.actual: Toast 'Test purchase: +100 gems'; gems go from 20 to 120 with no payment. The bottom banner is labelled 'Demo ad'.

findings.title: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy links on the age gate only show 'coming soon'
steps: Launch the game on a fresh profile
On the age gate, tap Privacy Policy
findings.actual: Toast 'Privacy Policy — coming soon'; same for Terms of Service and the Settings links

evidence.caption: toast({ privacy: 'Privacy Policy', terms: 'Terms of Service' }[key] + ' — coming soon')

findings.suggested_fix: Expected for a prototype. App stores require a reachable privacy policy for games that ask for age and show ads, so plan real pages before submission.

findings.title: Top bar overflows on 360-390 px phones: the Settings gear (menu) and the Close X (store) are cut or pushed off screen, completely from 9,999 coins
findings.environment: Web, touch, widths 360 / 390 / 412 px, 15 balance combinations per run
steps: Open the game on a 360 px wide phone (a very common Android width) with 9,999 coins
Look at the top-right corner of the main menu, then open the Store
findings.expected: Level, gems, coins and the Settings gear (menu) / Close X (store) all fit on screen at any balance
findings.actual: 360 px: gear 29 of 42 px visible at the starting balance, 0 px (fully off screen) at 9,999 and 98.8K/123.5K coins; the store has no visible Close X. 390 px: gear cut from 9,999 coins. 412 px: only the store X slightly cut at 98.8K/123.5K.

evidence.caption: 360 px store, 123.5K coins: no Close X
360 px, starting balance: gear already cut
Visible px of gear and X for 15 cases

findings.suspected_cause: The top-bar pills have fixed minimum widths and the row does not shrink or wrap below ~400 px; numbers from 1,000 to 9,999 are shown in full (formatNumber only abbreviates from 10,000), so they are the widest case.
findings.suggested_fix: Let the currency pills shrink (min-width: 0, smaller font under 400 px) and abbreviate from 1,000 (1.2K); keep the gear/X outside the flexible area so it can never be pushed out.

findings.title: Phone landscape (web): the Levels / Play block covers the Activities and Events buttons on the main menu
findings.environment: Web, 844x390 touch. The Android app is locked to portrait (AndroidManifest.xml:18), so this affects the browser build only
steps: Open the web build on a phone held in landscape
Tap Events (right side) or Activities (left side)
findings.expected: Side buttons are tappable, or the game asks to rotate to portrait
findings.actual: The .actions block (Levels and Play) lies on top of both buttons; a tap on their centre hits Play/Levels instead. The logo is also covered.

evidence.caption: Run 1: the Events click is intercepted by .actions
Run 2: probe reports both buttons covered by .actions

findings.suggested_fix: Show a 'rotate your phone' screen in landscape on touch devices (matching the portrait-only app), or give landscape its own menu layout.

findings.title: Add Slot from the Out of Slots popup has no maximum: repeated fails grow the board to 10 squeezed slots (the booster stops at 7)
findings.environment: Web, 390x844 touch. Fails triggered with the debug 'Lose level' (assisted); Add Slot and the ad are the real flow
steps: Start Flowers Easy level 1 (4 slots)
Run out of slots, tap 'Add Slot' on the Out of Slots popup and watch the 3 s ad
Run out of slots again and repeat 6 times
findings.expected: Same limit as the Add Slot booster: 'Maximum slots reached' at 7 slots
findings.actual: Slots go 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10. At 10 they shrink to thin pills across the full width and the first slot's block is wider than its neighbours.

evidence.caption: Run 1: the last Add Slot rounds
Booster: if (g.slots.length >= 7) return toast('Maximum slots reached')

findings.suspected_cause: The fail-popup handler pushes a slot without the 7-slot check that useBooster('add_slot') has.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply the same limit in 'fail-addslot' and hide or disable the Add Slot button on the fail popup at 7 slots.

findings.title: Store keeps selling the $4.99 Special Offer, which includes No Ads, to players who already own No Ads
findings.preconditions: No Ads owned (bought alone for $2.99 or in an earlier offer)
steps: Open the Store
Look at the Special Offer card
findings.expected: The offer is hidden once No Ads is owned, or shown without No Ads at a new price (the No Ads card already shows 'Owned')
findings.actual: The card still lists '1,200 gems · 10,000 coins · No Ads' for $4.99 and can be bought again; the toast says 'No Ads' was granted again. With real payments this charges for a non-consumable the player owns.

evidence.caption: Offer card with 'No Ads' while No Ads is owned
The offer card is always rendered in renderStore (no state.noAds check)
The offer popup already skips No Ads owners: if (... !state.noAds ...) openOffer()

findings.suspected_cause: renderStore() builds the offer card unconditionally, while maybeShowOffer() already checks state.noAds.
findings.suggested_fix: Hide the offer card when state.noAds is true (same rule as the popup), or show a variant without No Ads.

findings.title: A double tap on a coin pack buys two packs (no confirmation, no debounce)
steps: Store with 120 gems
Double-tap the 1,000 coins pack (30 gems)
findings.suggested_fix: If accidental purchases matter, ignore a second tap on the same item for ~500 ms, or add a confirm step for premium currency.

findings.title: Special Offer toast says '+10K coins' while the card and other toasts use full numbers ('10,000 coins', '+1,000 coins')
findings.expected: Test purchase: +1,200 gems, +10,000 coins, No Ads
findings.actual: Test purchase: +1,200 gems, +10K coins, No Ads

evidence.caption: uses the HUD formatNumber (K/M); renderStore uses a full-number formatter (app.js:311)

findings.suggested_fix: Use the store's full-number format in purchase toasts.

findings.title: Level Complete popup closes on a tap outside it or Escape: the coin reward is never paid and the player is left on an empty board
findings.environment: Web, 390x844 touch. Runs 1-2: tap outside; runs 3-4: Escape key
steps: Win Flowers Easy level 1 (Level Complete shows '+30')
Tap anywhere outside the popup card (or press Escape on a keyboard)
findings.expected: The popup stays open until Continue or Claim x2 is chosen (like the Out of Slots popup, which is locked), or closing it pays the reward and moves on
findings.actual: The popup closes, coins stay at 100 (the +30 is lost), the board is empty and there is no Continue button. The win itself is saved (3 stars), so the player can only leave through Pause.

evidence.caption: Run 1 as stills: popup, tap, empty board
After the tap: empty board, coins still 100
coins 100 before and after, progress saved
<div class="overlay rays" id="popup-complete" hidden> (no data-locked; popup-fail at index.html:458 has it)

findings.suspected_cause: popup-complete lacks the data-locked attribute, so the generic outside-tap and Escape handlers (app.js:237, 3028) close it without calling finishWin().
findings.suggested_fix: Add data-locked to #popup-complete (index.html:423), as #popup-fail already has.

findings.title: Several buttons are below the 44 px touch-target guideline on phones (top-bar currency buttons, store Buy, in-level Pause and Speed)
steps: Measure the on-screen size of every visible button on the menu, store, settings and a level
findings.expected: At least 44x44 CSS px (Apple HIG; Android recommends 48 dp)
findings.actual: Gems/coins top-bar buttons 76x34 and 79x34; store Buy buttons 95x38 (x6); Copy player ID 77x38; in-level Pause 40x40; Speed 67x36

evidence.caption: Level: Pause (top left) and Speed (top right)

findings.suggested_fix: Grow the hit area to 44 px without changing the art, e.g. padding or an ::after hit box on these buttons.
